target.title: fix: preserve tool-result text across media fallback and context pressure
target.body:
Refs #99241

## What Problem This Solves

This PR now covers both model-visible failure modes reported in #99241:

1. A mixed text/media tool result could be rendered as `(see attached image)` even when real text existed.
2. Under aggregate tool-result pressure, a freshly completed tool result could be cleared before provider dispatch when a runtime-context message was appended after it. Depending on the provider serializer, the model then saw empty output or an empty object.

The July 9 follow-up on this PR was therefore directionally correct: the original provider/media fix removed the placeholder symptom, but it did not address the upstream text loss.

## Root Cause and Fix

The original provider changes keep explicit tool-result text ahead of stale media placeholders.

The follow-up fix is in the prompt-projection truncation path. Aggregate recovery protects a fresh contiguous tail of tool results, but runtime context is appended after the tool loop. That made the fresh result no longer syntactically trailing, so saturated-history recovery could select it and clear its text.

The fix treats only a contiguous tail run of messages marked as OpenClaw runtime-context carriers as transparent while locating fresh trailing tool results. Substantive user/assistant messages remain boundaries. Historical results are still reduced to the aggregate budget, while the fresh result remains model-readable.

The branch was also merged with current `upstream/main`, including the runtime-context carrier propagation through the real `convertToLlm` boundary.

## User Impact

Long-lived sessions with heavy `exec` / `read` traffic should retain the newest tool output for the model even when aggregate recovery is active and runtime context is refreshed before provider dispatch. Media-only results keep their existing placeholder behavior, while mixed text/media results preserve their text.

No config change, migration, or new runtime option is required.

## Evidence

### Reproduction

- Before the follow-up fix, the focused saturated-history regression produced an empty fresh tool-result string (`expected '' to be 'ABC'`).
- The final regression uses the real `convertToLlm` boundary, verifies that `runtimeContextCarrier` survives provider conversion, and verifies that a 4,000-character fresh exec marker remains byte-for-byte intact while older history is reduced under a 32,000-character aggregate budget.

### Tests

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-truncation.test.ts`
  - 62 tests passed.
- Tool-result truncation + runtime-context/LLM-boundary suites
  - 118 tests passed.
- OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, shared tool-result-text, and transport-stream coverage
  - 711 tests passed.
- Prompt-cache stability suite
  - 13 tests passed.
- Core and extension test type-checks via `scripts/run-tsgo.mjs`
  - Passed.
- `oxlint`, `oxfmt --check`, and `git diff --check`
  - Passed.
- GitHub `Real behavior proof` check for head `346d30918f9`
  - Passed.

### Review

- `codex review --uncommitted`
  - No actionable defects.
- Repository autoreview (`gpt-5.5`, high reasoning)
  - `findings: []`; patch judged correct.



AI-assisted: reproduction, implementation, tests, and final review were performed with Codex.
